1936, August
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 136 Cont.
Aug. 18 Emma Feeney - 51 - prayed for liver cancer two weeks ago. Seems improving ..
19 Roland Montambs - 34 - uncle of Rob Le Beau - has no regard for mother. Only son - Mother here now from Lake Linden.
Warren Mayhes - fits. .
Arthur Guerin - 24 - fits. ..
Page 137 Aug. 19 Mary Geus - 47 - hay fever
20 Raymond Marentette - 13 (To-day) - Infantile Paryl. since 14 months old - for a time was dead from waist down; has improved till able to walk though with great difficulty; was greatly helpt by visit to good St. Ann's in Mont'1.
21 V. Sr. Bronislaus - Felician - Superintendent of schools .... cancer of liver. Drs. all hopeless in her regard - Very amiable character . Convent. Harry Dettloff - 35 - has wife and little girl of 4. Whole right side numb from stroke about a year ago.
25 V. Sister M. Bronislaus
Anna Dubber - 28 - pertini'us Jos. Clarkson - 24 - keeping undesirable company V. Anna Haig - 37 - Hemoraging
Page 138
Aug. 26 Francis P. O'Hare - 27 - clever professionel (news paper-man), grad- uated from high school at 17 But alas !... Completely lost to drink - breaking the hearts of his earnest parents.
26 Mrs. Ida Madigan - 30 about - Complications : "hopeless"
Mrs. Doras - 80 - well otherwise but memory failing - has forgotten where her $ is.
